description: Source code for a FreeType font driver handling PCF fonts, including functions for reading font tables, properties, metrics, bitmaps, encodings, and constructing font face objects.

methods.name: pcf_read_TOC
methods.description: Reads the Table of Contents from the font stream and populates the face's table entries, with validation and sorting.

methods.name: pcf_get_property
methods.description: Finds a property by name in the font face properties.

methods.name: pcf_get_properties
methods.description: Reads and parses font properties from the stream.

methods.name: pcf_get_metrics
methods.description: Reads font metrics from the stream.

methods.name: pcf_get_bitmaps
methods.description: Reads bitmap data for glyphs from the stream.

methods.name: pcf_get_encodings
methods.description: Reads character encoding mappings from the stream.

methods.name: pcf_get_accel
methods.description: Reads acceleration (bounds) data for the font.

methods.name: pcf_interpret_style
methods.description: Interprets style-related properties (e.g., slant, weight) and sets style flags.

methods.name: pcf_load_font
methods.description: Main function to load a PCF font, reading tables, properties, metrics, bitmaps, encodings, and constructing the font face object.
